name: lean-quota-monitor
description: Monitor AI usage limits, quotas, reset times, and credits in the VS Code status bar — Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini/Antigravity, MiniMax, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek, and Devin.

leanQuotaMonitor.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Automatic refresh interval in seconds (minimum: 30, default: 180).

leanQuotaMonitor.statusBarAlignment.description: Status Bar placement: right or left (default: right, restart required).

leanQuotaMonitor.lowQuotaWarningThreshol.description: Remaining quota percentage threshold that triggers a ⚠️ warning in the Status Bar (default: 20%). When any duration window (5hour, 1day, 1week, 1month) drops to or below this threshold, it temporarily replaces the default window with a ⚠️ warning. Select 'off' to disable warnings and keep the default window pinned.

leanQuotaMonitor.providerOrder.description: Display order for built-in and custom providers. Edit this setting in settings.json; Hover arrow controls update it automatically.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenAI Codex quota (default: Codex).

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for OpenAI Codex quota (default: GPT).

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiVisible.description: Show OpenAI Codex quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiPrimaryWindow.description: Default Quota Window On Status Bar for OpenAI Codex. 'auto' uses the provider default (longest duration: 1week); a shorter window at or below the Low Quota Warning Threshold preempts with ⚠️.

leanQuotaMonitor.customProviders.description: Custom Providers. Key = Provider Name; statusBarName = Status Bar Name; script stdout = Status Output. Scripts must exit 0 and print exactly one non-empty Status Output without the Status Bar Name; rendered Status Bar text is capped at 10 characters.

statusBarName.description: Status Bar Name. The script stdout is the Status Output and must not repeat this name.

script.description: Executable script path; no shell command or arguments.

visible.description: Show this custom provider in the Status Bar. Hover and Quick Pick remain visible.
